keyVerseDR: "A new commandment I give unto you: That you love one another, as I have loved you." (Jn 13:34)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Love
level1.story: Love means caring for the people close to us, like family and friends. Jesus loves us first!
level1.keyLine: I love because Jesus loves me.
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice love all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: How did we show love to each other this week?
Who outside our home can we love better?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level1.prayer: Jesus, You loved me first. Help me love my family and friends as You love me. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Give a family member a big hug
TUE: Say 'I love you' to someone
WED: Spend time with a brother or sister
THU: Draw a picture for someone you love
FRI: Pray for each person in your family
SAT: Help a parent without being asked

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Love
level2.story: Love means valuing close relationships, where we give and receive care. It is shown in hugs, kind words, time together, and sacrifices for each other. Jesus gave us a new commandment: love one another as I have loved you. Our families are the first place we learn to love, and God's love is the source of all love.
level2.keyLine: I love because Jesus loves me.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice love all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: How did we show love to each other this week?
How did God help us grow in love?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
level2.prayer: Jesus, You loved me first. Help me love my family and friends as You love me. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Spend screen-free time with your family
TUE: Write a note telling someone why you love them
WED: Call or visit a grandparent
THU: Do a family member's chore for them
FRI: Listen to someone's whole day
SAT: Pray together as a family tonight

art.mainBrief: A Catholic family practicing love together at home
art.heartBrief: Stars and a family around a heart
